provider: CUHK Department of Cultural and Religious Studies 2025-26 Major Programme Requirement and Course List
note: The official 2025-26 Study Scheme publishes a 66-unit standard Major and a 51-unit senior-entry Major. The standard Major includes a 9-unit Faculty Package, 24 units of Required Courses and 33 units of Elective Courses; it also offers Religion and Culture, Religious Education, Arab Studies, and Religion and Health concentrations. This supplement exposes all 63 courses in the official Religious Studies Areas 1-5, including their current titles, 3-unit values, required-choice roles and Capstone options. It does not import the two required Cultural Studies Area electives, cross-department Faculty Package choices, EDUC/ANTH/ARAB/PSYC concentration choices, or other THEO electives allowed with limits because those open pools are outside the Religious Studies course list. Course reuse restrictions, concentration substitutions, the five-course THEO limit and the senior-entry path require manual review. The resulting list is intentionally browse-only and must not be presented as a complete 66-unit graduation audit.
